context_for_next_testing_agent: Audio timeline fix (v2) and slide progress bar feature verified. The player.js playSlideAudio now has 3 modes: (1) Timeline mode when any audio has startTime > 0 - schedules via setTimeout. (2) Sequential mode for multiple audios with all startTime=0 - chains via 'ended' event. (3) Single audio mode - plays immediately. The slide progress bar is a 4px (6px on hover) bar at the bottom of #slide-wrapper that fills from 0-100% based on slide duration using setInterval(50ms). When complete, it adds 'complete' class that changes to green with pulse animation. All previous fixes remain intact: keyboard guard checks tagName for input/textarea, tutor has stopPropagation on keydown/keyup/keypress.

audio_timeline_fix.issue: Multiple audios on a slide played simultaneously instead of at their scheduled startTime positions
audio_timeline_fix.fix_details: playSlideAudio rewritten with hasExplicitTimeline check and 3 modes. Timeline mode uses setTimeout to schedule audio at startTime*1000 ms. Sequential mode chains via 'ended' event. Single mode plays immediately.

slide_progress_bar.feature: Thin progress bar at bottom of slide showing animation progress, turns green when complete
slide_progress_bar.details: 4px bar (6px on hover) at bottom of #slide-wrapper. Uses setInterval(50ms) to update width from 0% to 100% based on slide duration. Adds 'complete' class at 100% which changes to green (#22c55e/#16a34a) with 2x pulse animation.
